subject: prd/implement-now
statement: A normal run with no ready implementation and no applicable review obligation performs no routing, claim, reviewer, or model work; a review-only recovery run never routes/claims implementation and never scans or attempts an unselected obligation.
rationale: zero combined work remains zero inference, while recovery cannot launder pending work or widen the driver's bound
fit_criterion: combined-empty fixtures emit zero work; selected/unselected/exhausted fixtures prove byte-identical task/proposal identities, zero implementation launches, and zero unselected review reads/attempts
